description_for_human: Persistent memory for AI agents. Store and recall text, audio, and documents across sessions.
description_for_model: Persistent semantic memory API. Endpoints: POST /remember (ingest text, audio, or document URLs; returns summary, action items, entities), POST /recall (plain-English query, returns synthesized answer with cited sources), POST /note (lightweight write without chunking). Idempotent by default; SSE streaming on /recall?stream=1. Free tier: 100 writes + 100 reads/month.
